hypotheses.justification: `NeZero p` is implied by the later hypothesis `hp : p.Prime`, because `hp.ne_zero : p ≠ 0`. The statement does not need it to elaborate. I checked the pieces that mention `p`. `Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) K`, `X ^ p`, `herm (unitaryInvolution K ℓ f)`, `SUid (unitaryInvolution K ℓ f) p`, `TorusFourierGenU h p` and `HeisTensor.Cent` have no `NeZero` requirement. `unitarySU` is `StatedSU n (p^f) K`, and `Cent` has only `Field K` and `σ : K ≃+* K` as variables. `unitaryInvolution` needs `[Finite K]`, `[Fact ℓ.Prime]` and `[CharP K ℓ]`, not `NeZero p`. The proof only needs the instance because it calls `heis_frame_unitary` and `gj_comm_of_fourier`, which take `[NeZero p]`. Adding `haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩` at the start of the proof supplies it, so the theorem stays true and provable with this binder deleted.
